## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, the change, and the affected user/contributor workflow. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands and actual results. State unavailable or skipped checks and why. Include a deterministic scene/input and expected value/tolerance for acoustic changes; separate listening impressions from numerical/browser results.

## Compatibility and evidence

Explain any schema, formula, material, Worker/audio, security, dependency, or deployment change. Link an ADR for consequential decisions. Confirm new assets have redistribution rights and attribution.

## Remaining limits

Record material risks, known failures, or work that needs host-browser listening, a Docker daemon, or another environment. Do not include secrets or private audio.
